chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

The Statement of the Exalted: 'And you were on the brink of a pit of fire, then He saved you from it through Muhammad.' By Allah, this is how Jibraeel (peace be upon him) came down with it upon Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: How did the Angel Jibraeel reveal the verse about being saved from the fire through Muhammad?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the grammatical and theological nuance of Quran 3:103, asserting that the phrase 'through Muhammad' refers to the Angel Jibraeel delivering the revelation directly to the Prophet, thereby affirming the divine source of the specific wording. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the precise transmission of the Quranic text and the role of the Angel as the intermediary of divine speech. The commentary underscores the continuity between the prophetic reception of the verse and its ultimate meaning regarding God's deliverance of the believers.
